# Documentation Navigation

The [active Typst thesis](typst/thesis/main.pdf) and its
[source](typst/thesis/main.typ) own the scientific narrative. Executable
contracts are owned by the
[package code](https://github.com/JanDuchscherer104/ARIA-NBV/tree/main/aria_nbv/aria_nbv)
and [tests](https://github.com/JanDuchscherer104/ARIA-NBV/tree/main/aria_nbv/tests).
Measurements and provenance are owned by validated rollout manifests and report
bundles, with their document interface indexed by the
[reproducibility appendix](typst/thesis/appendix/index.typ).

## Thesis and Seminar Paper

- [Thesis](typst/thesis/main.pdf), [Typst Source](typst/thesis/main.typ): Scientific narrative and interpretation of directly cited evidence.
- [Project Paper](typst/seminar_paper/main.pdf), [Typst Source](typst/seminar_paper/main.typ): Historical implemented evidence from the earlier project phase: Single-step RRI based scene scorer.
